title: Predictive Modeling Project Context
summary: Project Context completed with business objective, intended use, target definition, population definition, observation window, and performance window.

payload.businessObjective: Reduce confirmed card-fraud losses by flagging high-risk transactions for review before settlement.
payload.intendedModelUse: A fraud analyst reviews the model's risk score alongside case history and decides whether to hold, decline, or release the transaction; the model output does not auto-decline.
payload.targetDefinition: Whether a given transaction was later confirmed as fraudulent by the card network's chargeback and dispute process.
payload.populationDefinition: All card-present and card-not-present transactions processed through the authorization system during the observation period.
payload.observationWindow: Transaction attributes available at authorization time, including amount and the anonymized behavioral PCA components captured by the fraud data platform.
payload.performanceWindow: Fraud confirmation outcome finalized within 120 days after the transaction date via chargeback or dispute resolution.
